Purpose: establish auditable operating rules for AI-assisted social media customer response. Fictional academic simulation; no policy is represented as live or legally approved.
Policy authority and controls
Higher-priority safety, applicable law, privacy and verified incident procedure supersede routine templates. AI may draft but must not autonomously publish, refund, modify accounts or make legal admissions. Case-specific claims require authenticated system evidence.
